slides.cap: Historical connection: Renewed struggle over Finland and the Soviet frontier
slides.body: The Winter War was the first part of a longer struggle over Finland's frontier with the Soviet Union. Finland's territorial losses and the wider German-Soviet war led directly to renewed fighting.

slides.title: Before the Soviet-Finnish Wars
slides.body:
Soviet security demands and Finland's refusal to cede strategic territory led to the Winter War; Finland later joined Germany's invasion to recover its losses.

The Conflict Takes Shape: Finland fought for survival and lost territory, while the Soviet Union sought to secure Leningrad and its northwestern frontier. The opening phase established the political goals, alliances, and military problems that shaped every later campaign.

Why This Moment Matters: Soviet-Finnish wars was more than an isolated engagement. It helped define the conflict's direction and exposed the strengths and weaknesses of the opposing sides. Finland fought for survival and lost territory, while the Soviet Union sought to secure Leningrad and its northwestern frontier.

Consequences: The effects of Soviet-Finnish wars extended beyond its immediate result. Repeated mobilization, evacuation, territorial loss, and frontline destruction burdened Finnish and Soviet civilians and soldiers. Its place in the wider campaign also influenced later military choices and political calculations.

slides.title: International Dimension
slides.body:
The wars intersected first with Allied sympathy for Finland and later with the German-Soviet struggle on the Eastern Front.

The Human Cost: Repeated mobilization, evacuation, territorial loss, and frontline destruction burdened Finnish and Soviet civilians and soldiers.

title: Outcome and Legacy
sub: How the Soviet-Finnish Wars ended and what followed

slides.title: The End of the Soviet-Finnish Wars
slides.body: Finland preserved independence but ceded territory and accepted strict armistice terms. It then expelled German troops from Lapland.

slides.title: War Summary: Soviet-Finnish Wars
